reason: Example. Direct coinvariant computations for S_2 and S_3 with their graded pieces and multiplicities. Corrected in this dispatch: for the deg x = 2 convention the Hilbert series are 1+t^2 and (1+t^2)(1+t^2+t^4), the graded pieces sit in degrees 0,2,4,6 for S_3, and the multiplicities are 1 for the trivial module, t^6 for the sign module and t^2+t^4 for the standard module (the earlier text wrongly spoke of four irreducible constituents and fake degrees 1,t). Deps: A1, A4, A5, A8 and the published Hilbert-series lemma; sources read (Soergel 1990 Section 1.1; Garnier Remark 4.20(2)). Level 3.
